I added every page screenshot to `docs/WRITEUP.md`, in a new "Every page, screenshot by screenshot" section right under the Demo video. I committed and pushed it.

- **Landing:** the desktop landing page, the landing page on a phone, and the Studio section of the landing page.

- **Results:** the kit ready in 55 seconds, studio photos, image deck, video ad, keywords/tags/SEO title, and the "double-check" list.

# Start backend + frontend + an HTTPS tunnel so the app opens on your phone over ANY network

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
LOG="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sellcraft-dev"; mkdir -p "$LOG"
PIDS=()
cleanup() { for p in "${PIDS[@]:-}"; do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

command -v cloudflared >/dev/null || { echo "Install it first: brew install cloudflared"; exit 1; }

MODE="${1:-prod}"
# The tunnel makes the app reachable from the internet, so require a random access code (carried in the QR link).
ACCESS_CODE="$(openssl rand -hex 4)"; export ACCESS_CODE
echo "$ACCESS_CODE" > "$LOG/access_code"
RELOAD=""; [ "$MODE" = "--dev" ] && RELOAD="--reload"
(cd "$ROOT/backend" && exec .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 $RELOAD) >"$LOG/api.log" 2>&1 &
PIDS+=($!)
if [ "$MODE" = "--dev" ]; then
  (cd "$ROOT/frontend" && exec npm run dev -- -H 127.0.0.1) >"$LOG/web.log" 2>&1 &
else
  echo "Building production frontend..."
  (cd "$ROOT/frontend" && npm run build) >"$LOG/build.log" 2>&1 || { echo "Build failed. See $LOG/build.log"; exit 1; }
  (cd "$ROOT/frontend" && exec npm run start -- -H 127.0.0.1) >"$LOG/web.log" 2>&1 &
fi
PIDS+=($!)

echo "Waiting for the app..."
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
  curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1
done
curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health >/dev/null || { echo "App didn't start. See $LOG/*.log"; exit 1; }

cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:3000 --no-autoupdate >"$LOG/tunnel.log" 2>&1 &
PIDS+=($!)

content.text:
The landing page was the empty one, so I replaced its single full-page screenshot with 11 frames. Each frame was taken after the scroll animation finished, and I pushed the change to `docs/WRITEUP.md`. I checked the frames on a contact sheet but haven't opened the writeup rendered on DEV.

The frames, in order:
1. Hero
2. Start with the photo you already have
3. Facts become a listing
4. One input, every deliverable
5. Interactive studio
6. Written the way each channel works
7. Video ad
8. Upload once, get the lot
9. Same facts, your voice
10. Three steps
11. Call to action

I scrolled in small steps and waited about 3.5 seconds on each frame. For the sections that animate as you scroll, I stopped where the content is fully on screen rather than mid-fade.

The other pages (create steps, results, stores) have no scroll animation, so I left them as they were. The frames are in `docs/images/web/landing/`, and I deleted the old full-page `01-landing.jpg`.

I used a temporary dev server on port 3100 and stopped it afterwards. The server on port 3000 still shows "Internal Server Error", so rebuild it before your next demo.
